text: Ñalnde yedduɓe Allah ɓen ɓe fenni Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen, weeɓitiroytee e Yiite ngen fii lepteede, ɓe feliree wi'aneede: on lanniino fii moƴƴi mon ɗin ka nguurdam mon aduna, dakmitorɗon welii-fotii. Hannde non, on yoɓitirte lepte hoynooje on, sabu ko townitoraynoɗon kon ka hoore leydi, ko aldaa e goonga, e sabu ko yaltirnoɗon kon e ɗoftaare Allah, geddi e keeferaaku.
